payload.body: You tend to stay restrained until someone else becomes forceful, then meet them with more intensity than the situation seemed to require. At other times, you become the direct one while the other person refuses to act. Underneath is often an old lesson that only one person was allowed to be angry, decisive, or difficult. Say what you want before one person becomes the angry one and the other becomes the restrained one.
payload.astroHint: Lilith opposite Mars can make assertion feel as if it belongs either to you or to the person across from you, but not both.
